name: Commitguard
description: Installs the published Commitguard v0.2.0 native guard and activates guarded Git for the workspace on every container start. Requires a human github.com gh login.

autoActivate.description: Activate the guard on container start. While not activated, ordinary Git fails closed with login/setup instructions. When false, Git runs unguarded until /usr/local/share/commitguard/setup is run manually.
